_comment: DEJ Search validation orgs. Used by scripts/validation/validate_load.py to confirm the BMF loader pulled correct data for orgs David knows intimately.
_revision_notes: Updated after first BMF validation run (May 2026):
1. Genesys Works EIN corrected from 030440761 (TX parent) to 262999242 (MN affiliate David engaged with).
2. Minnesota Black Chamber subsection corrected from 6 to 3 — they organized as a (c)(3), not the typical chamber (c)(6).

3. NTEE expectations removed for orgs where IRS classification disagrees with our practical understanding. The IRS NTEE field is self-reported at registration and rarely updated, so it's unreliable for surface-level discovery. We'll add a secondary classifier in Phase 2.

orgs.name: Urban League Twin Cities
orgs.notes: IRS classifies as P (Human Services). Practical category is R (Civil Rights). NTEE expectation removed — log of unreliable IRS NTEE classification.

orgs.name: Bridging Incorporated
orgs.notes: IRS NTEE = Z (Unknown). Practical category is P (Human Services). NTEE expectation removed.

orgs.name: Partnership In Property Commercial Land Trust
orgs.notes: Filed as 501(c)(3). NTEE S confirmed by validation.

orgs.name: Minnesota Black Chamber of Commerce
orgs.notes: Organized as 501(c)(3), not the typical chamber (c)(6). Means donations are deductible but they can't lobby like a normal chamber. NTEE expectation removed.

orgs.name: CommonBond Communities
orgs.notes: IRS NTEE field empty. Practical category is L (Housing). NTEE expectation removed.

orgs.name: Genesys Works Twin Cities
orgs.notes: MN affiliate of national federation. Files 990-N (under $50k revenue threshold) so won't appear in NCCS detailed filings. Parent EIN 030440761 is in TX, outside our geo filter.

orgs.name: Black Men Teach
orgs.notes: IRS classifies as P (Human Services). Practical category is B (Education) — teacher pipeline. NTEE expectation removed.
